# Files from the ERC-7730 registry

`calldata-UniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager.json` is copied unchanged from [ethereum/clear-signing-erc7730-registry](https://github.com/ethereum/clear-signing-erc7730-registry) at commit `4754709` (`registry/uniswap/`). The registry is published under CC0 1.0.

It is here so that the tests can show the calls the router forwards to the v3 position manager. A wallet takes this file from the registry, not from here.
